2610.04740.title: Toward a Locally Deployable Agentic Co-Scientist: Small-Model Planning for Early-Stage Drug Discovery
2610.04740.paper_summary: Early-stage computational drug discovery requires coordinating heterogeneous scientific tools across multi-step workflows. We present a lightweight, tool-augmented framework in which a locally deployable compact language model plans calls to 18 modular tools. A Unified Molecular Schema maintains shared molecular records, while a plug-in interface supports tool replacement and extension. We construct 1,263 manually refined query-plan pairs through workflow-graph path coverage and apply LoRA fine-tuning to three compact model families. Under the query-level split, all fine-tuned models generate fully parseable and schema-compliant plans on 47 held-out cross-group queries. Llama 3.2-3B achieves a tool-selection F1 of 0.998, sequence exact match of 0.979, and argument F1 of 0.960. Under the stricter workflow-grouped split, which excludes identical ordered tool sequences across partitions, sequence exact match reaches 0.452 to 0.548, highlighting the remaining difficulty for compact models in generating complete workflow paths unseen during training. These results demonstrate the feasibility of compact, locally deployable planning while identifying compositional generalization as an important direction for further improvement.
2610.04740.paper_summary_zh: 早期計算藥物發現需要協調異質科學工具，跨越多步驟工作流程。<lb/>我們提出了一個輕量級的工具增強框架，其中一個本地可部署的緊湊語言模型計劃調用18個模塊化工具。<lb/>統一分子架構維護共享的分子記錄，而插件介面則支持工具的替換和擴展。<lb/>我們通過工作流程圖路徑覆蓋構建了1,263對手動精煉的查詢計劃對，並對三個緊湊模型系列應用LoRA微調。<lb/>在查詢級別的拆分下，所有微調的模型在47個保留的跨組查詢上生成完全可解析且符合架構的計劃。<lb/>Llama 3.2-3B達到了0.998的工具選擇F1，0.979的序列精確匹配，以及0.960的參數F1。<lb/>在更嚴格的工作流程分組拆分下，該拆分排除了跨分區的相同有序工具序列，序列精確匹配達到了0.452到0.548，突顯了緊湊模型在生成訓練期間未見的完整工作流程路徑方面的困難。<lb/>這些結果展示了緊湊、本地可部署規劃的可行性，同時確定了組合泛化作為進一步改進的重要方向。
